description: Push to an iPhone/iPad without a session: K_push = HKDF-SHA256(PRK, empty salt, info "handlive/v1/push", L = 32); the envelope is built as over a session and encrypted with K_push exactly as 0.5.1 (payload = b64(nonce(24) ‖ ciphertext ‖ tag(16)), AAD = UTF-8 "<v>|<type>|<id>|<ts>"); env_b64 = standard base64 (with padding) of the UTF-8 envelope JSON, sent as env_b64 of POST /v1/push and as hl of the APNs payload. I-NSE derives K_push from the PRK of pair p, decodes hl, rebuilds the AAD from the parsed envelope and decrypts. APNs thread-id is the generic sms or calls; collapse_key is the message_key of an SMS, call:<call_id> for a call. Envelopes with a truncation object pin the SMS text cut: body over 1,000 code points → first 999 and "…"; while env_b64 > 3,000 the body, then the snippet, becomes the longest cut that fits, again ending with "…" (code points, never UTF-16 units).
source: docs/detailed-design/00-common-specs.md 0.4.4, 0.5.1, 0.6.1; 03-connectivity.md CONN-04 step 5b, API 2, API 4; 05-sms.md SMS-02 API 2; 06-call-control.md CALL-01 API 4; PRK from pair-prk.json
